title: TipsOverlayConfigResult
description: tips.overlay-config-result@1: answers about overlay configs on OpenVibe.Tips (tips.overlay.config.get, tips.overlay.config.update). GET /api/v1/overlay-configs?creator= → { configs } (oldest first); GET /api/v1/overlay-configs/:id, POST /api/v1/overlay-configs (201) and PATCH /api/v1/overlay-configs/:id → { config }. For the creator or a service holding the capability; 404 tips.overlay_config_not_found.
